item.text: {"criteria":[{"id":"FIRST_004_1","observation":"The response explicitly rejects an immediate merger, identifies the causal claim as untested, proposes tracing the repeated step to locate the duplicate-entry source, highlights different approval rules and independent deployment as separation costs, and compares smaller template and export/import remedies before treating runtime consolidation as a candidate.","status":"pass","turn_reviews":[]},{"id":"FIRST_004_2","observation":"The response provides a discriminating next move—a one-week trace followed by a trial of the smallest remedy, with clear conditions for reconsidering or stopping merger investigation—but it does not assign an owner for that action.","status":"fail","turn_reviews":[]}]}
